_comment: Cycle counts for the bandwidth / energy-per-bit calculations. ddr_write_cycles and ddr_read_cycles are filled in after the board run (7-segment display, SW[7:6] = 01 / 10, plus the upper bits from SW[7:6] = 11). Until then the estimates per word are used. The BRAM numbers come from tb_bram_top (simulation); put the board values in the *_board fields.
